title: Moving the Monthly Due Date on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contract
content:
**Conditions.** A due-date change on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be made only while the contract status is active. The contract must show 0 days past due, a count of installments satisfied of at least the tier's minimum, and due-date changes used below the tier's lifetime maximum. All of these are read from the contract record.

**Interval.** A due-date change may take effect no earlier than the tier's interval in calendar months after the last due-date change took effect. The interval is counted in calendar months from the last due-date change date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to that month's last day when the day does not exist; a contract that has never changed its due date has no interval to wait. A change on the day the interval ends is permitted.

**New due day.** The new due day must lie between the tier's earliest and latest due day of the month, and the first installment on the new due day may fall no more than the tier's maximum shift in calendar days after the current next due date and never before it.

**Relationship alignment.** A change whose new due day equals the due day of another open Kestrel retail, pre-owned or balloon contract, or of an active Kestrel lease, of the same customer is a relationship alignment and does not have to wait for the interval; it still counts toward the lifetime maximum.

**Effect.** No fee is charged; simple interest continues to accrue daily, so a longer gap to the first installment on the new due day increases the interest portion of that installment. The change updates the due day, the next due date, the due-date changes used and the last due-date change date on the contract; the maturity date moves to the new due day in the final month.

## Interval boundary (hypothetical, 12-month interval)

| Last change took effect | Interval ends | Change effective the day before | Change effective on that day |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 10th of a month | The 10th of the same month a year later | Not permitted | Permitted |
| 29 February of a leap year | 28 February of the next year | Not permitted | Permitted |

## Points of judgement

- A relationship alignment skips the interval but never the lifetime maximum, the status, the days-past-due or the installments-satisfied conditions.
- A first installment on the new due day falling before the current next due date is never permitted, whatever the shift allowance.
